metadata.description: AI-Powered Legal Consultation Platform - Frontend Specification

principles.principle: Clean interfaces with purposeful whitespace, focusing user attention on what matters. Every element earns its place through function, not decoration.
Premium visual language that conveys reliability, expertise, and security. Legal services demand gravitas balanced with approachability.
Micro-animations and transitions that feel responsive and polished. Movement communicates state changes and guides user focus.
WCAG AAA compliant where possible, AA minimum. Designs work for everyone. High contrast, clear typography, logical tab order.
Optimized assets, lazy loading, skeleton states. The fastest interface is the one that feels instant.

design_inspirations.inspiration: Apple Human Interface - Premium feel and attention to detail

logo.primary: Modern scales of justice with geometric AI circuit elements
logo.tagline: न्याय सबके लिए | Justice for All

construction.clear_space: Minimum 1.5x logo height on all sides

icon_variants.full: Complete logo with wordmark - for headers, marketing
icon_variants.compact: Monogram "NS" with scales icon - for app icons, favicons
icon_variants.mono: Single color version - for watermarks, dark backgrounds
icon_variants.animated: Subtle scale balance animation for loading states

usage_dont.dont: Never place on busy backgrounds without container

brand_voice.tone: Professional yet approachable, confident but not arrogant
brand_voice.personality: Trusted advisor, knowledgeable friend, reliable partner

brand_values.value: Trust & Reliability - Security you can depend on
Accessibility - Legal help for everyone, regardless of background
Innovation - Modern solutions for traditional challenges
Indian Heritage - Built for India, with global standards

color_palette.color_philosophy: Deep, sophisticated primary colors that convey trust and expertise. Strategic use of accent colors to highlight actions and status. Generous use of neutrals for content-heavy interfaces.

neutral_colors.note: Slate - Cool gray with subtle blue undertone for digital screens

surface_colors.note: Semantic surface colors for consistent UI

typography.typography_philosophy: Typography establishes hierarchy, improves readability, and conveys brand personality. We use a carefully curated type stack optimized for digital screens and legal content.

display_font.name: Cal Sans
display_font.usage: Hero headlines, marketing pages, brand moments
display_font.characteristics: Modern geometric sans with distinctive character

body_font.name: Inter
body_font.variable_font: true - use for smooth weight transitions

mono_font.name: JetBrains Mono

type_scale.note: Fluid typography with clamp() for smooth responsive scaling

spacing_system.spacing_philosophy: Consistent spacing creates visual rhythm and hierarchy. Use the 4px base grid for precision, 8px for component internals. Generous whitespace elevates the premium feel.

design_system.border_radius:
Larger radii for containers, smaller for internal elements. Consistent rounding creates visual harmony.

shadows.note: Layered shadow system for depth perception
shadows.philosophy: Shadows establish visual hierarchy and depth. Use sparingly - elevation should be meaningful. Colored shadows add warmth and brand connection.

animations.motion_philosophy: Motion should be purposeful, guiding attention and providing feedback. Animations feel natural - never jarring or distracting. Respect user preferences for reduced motion (prefers-reduced-motion).

faq_item.question: How do I book a consultation?
faq_item.answer: Search for lawyers, select your preferred advocate, choose a time slot, and make payment. You'll receive confirmation and meeting details instantly.

faq_item.question: Is my information confidential?
faq_item.answer: Absolutely. We follow strict data protection practices. All communications are encrypted, and lawyer-client privilege is maintained.

faq_item.question: What if I'm not satisfied with the consultation?
faq_item.answer: We have a satisfaction guarantee. If you're not happy with your consultation, you can raise a dispute and we'll review it for a potential refund.

faq_item.question: How are lawyers verified?
faq_item.answer: All lawyers go through a rigorous verification process including Bar Council verification, document check, and background screening.

faq_item.question: Can I use the platform in Hindi?
faq_item.answer: Yes! Our platform supports both Hindi and English. You can switch languages anytime from your profile settings.

meta.description: Learn about Nyaay Saathi's mission to make legal services accessible to every Indian citizen.

content.title: Making Justice Accessible
content.subtitle: Our mission is to bridge the gap between citizens and legal services across India.

paragraphs.p: Founded in 2024, Nyaay Saathi was born from a simple observation: millions of Indians struggle to access quality legal services due to cost, location, or lack of awareness.
We combined cutting-edge AI technology with a network of verified lawyers to create a platform that makes legal help accessible, affordable, and convenient.

card.title: Our Mission
card.text: To democratize access to legal services by leveraging technology, ensuring every Indian can get quality legal guidance regardless of their location or economic status.

card.title: Our Vision
card.text: A future where legal awareness is universal, justice is accessible to all, and technology serves as the bridge between citizens and their legal rights.
